user_reviews.Name: Lohith Prasad
user_reviews.Description:
Very disappointing experience.

The shop is listed as closing at 10:00 PM, so I travelled there for a few simple black-and-white A4 printouts. When I arrived, the lights were on, computers were running, and staff were actively working inside. I have attached photos, including one showing the time on their computer screen.

Despite this, I was told the shop was “closed” and was given no explanation. When I pointed out that the advertised closing time was 10:00 PM, I was met with a dismissive and arrogant response.

I have no issue if a business refuses service, but then the closing time should be updated accordingly. Don’t advertise that you’re open until 10:00 PM if customers will be turned away before then. Very poor customer service and an unnecessarily rude attitude.

user_reviews.Description:
Very bad service and highly unprofessional behavior.

They made a printing mistake and refused to accept it. When the prints were delivered, the edge details were not printed properly, but instead of owning the error, they blamed me and said I should have checked it.

I was forced to pay again for the reprint even though the mistake was clearly from their side. This is extremely unprofessional.

Be very careful if you plan to print with ARUN CADD. Make sure to check every detail—color accuracy, missing details, alignment, and edge cuts—on the spot, even if it’s 100 or 500 copies. Otherwise, you may be held responsible for their printing errors.

This place used to be highly service oriented. Like this guy will never fail whatever happens. He stocked the most relevant stationary products.

Long story short - this shop told me his copier is out of order. And he had a smile on his face.

I wish him well.

user_reviews.Name: Trupti Lotlikar
user_reviews.Description:
Not reliable for courier services. Total waste of time, money, and commitment.
I booked ST Courier express service based on the owner’s recommendation on 28/01 from Bangalore to Chennai for ₹300, and it still has not reached the destination. When I followed up, the owner was very cold in response and said the parcel was held due to overload (i.e., it was not sent on the 28th even though extra charges were taken for express). I learnt about the delay only when I tracked the order. Now, on 29th, he assured me it would be dispatched and delivered by 1 PM on 30th.

When I messaged at 4 PM for an update, I was told the receiver was not responding to calls. However, when I connected the courier guy directly with the receiver, the receiver clearly asked him to hand over the courier at the given address, which he refused to do. The courier guy was talking as if he was doing a charity for us. At this point, I am sure the parcel will be returned.

This experience felt like an attempt to extract extra money without any real commitment to service. My time, commitments, and express charges were all lost. Overall, not dependable for courier needs—okay only for stationery purchases.

user_reviews.Name: Raghuram Gannavarapu
user_reviews.Description:
I had booked a design slot at Printo HSR Layout to create a photo book for my daughter’s birthday. Due to unavoidable reasons, I had to postpone the appointment a couple of times, and I truly appreciate how accommodating and generous the staff were in rescheduling the slots as per my convenience.

I visited the Printo branch on the day of the design session. Although my slot was initially booked for just one hour, it eventually took nearly 8 hours to complete the entire photo book — and throughout the process, the designer, Santhosh, was absolutely exceptional. His patience, creativity, and dedication stood out from start to finish.

Santhosh perfectly understood our vision and helped us enhance the design in ways we hadn’t imagined. He was incredibly supportive, attentive to detail, and ensured the final photo book turned out beautifully. If you’re planning to create a photo book and would like professional design assistance, Santhosh is definitely the person to approach. 5 starts for Santosh as well.

The final output quality was excellent, and the pricing was very reasonable compared to other photo studios offering similar services at much higher costs.

I would highly recommend Printo for anyone looking to create memorable photo books with great quality, thoughtful service, and talented designers.

user_reviews.reply_text_original:
Thank you for sharing your feedback.

At Navamodi Prints, printing and finishing are treated as distinct services. In this case, the order consisted of a small quantity of A3 sheets printed as provided. Cutting individual posters is not included by default and is undertaken only when specifically requested and feasible.

For professional machine cutting, minimum quantity requirements apply. For very small quantities, only manual cutting is possible, which involves additional labor, affects finish consistency, and is therefore chargeable. This is why cutting was neither assumed nor bundled into the printing cost.

Our pricing reflects the work executed and the processes involved. We maintain clear standards and do not compromise established print practices to meet unrealistic expectations.

We appreciate you taking the time to share your feedback.

At Navamodi Prints, we follow standard printing practices to ensure consistent and professional output. During the sample stage, our team explained that for two-sided prints, designs placed too close to the edge without bleed can be affected during cutting due to natural alignment variation, which may result in the artwork being trimmed on one side.

Rather than proceeding in a way that could compromise the final result, we advised a minor design adjustment to maintain print quality. While different vendors may choose different approaches, we do not recommend or execute processes that risk an unsatisfactory outcome.

We believe in being upfront about technical limitations and maintaining quality standards for every order.

user_reviews.Name: Arhan Roy
user_reviews.Description:
Extremely disappointing experience at Madhavam E Shop, Whitefield.

I got a black & white spiral-bound book printed with 106 pages. I was charged ₹1540 for printing alone (₹15 per B&W page) plus ₹150 for spiral binding, despite the rate card displayed in the shop clearly mentioning lower pricing for B&W printouts/xerox.

What disappointed me even more was the behaviour. Before even starting the work, they insisted on a ₹200 advance payment. I only agreed because the shop was close to my house and I urgently needed the work done.

When I politely questioned the pricing and pointed out that the displayed rates were lower, instead of explaining professionally, the owner became rude and dismissive. He made comments comparing me to students from “Deens” school who apparently “pay the same without bargaining,” and also mentioned that his children study in the USA and that people returning from the USA don’t hesitate to spend extra money.

As a student, money matters to me. Asking for fair pricing is not “bargaining too much.” I even helped with part of the binding work because the owner was alone and elderly, yet there was still no consideration or transparency in pricing.

The saddest part is that online services and even nearby local shops charge significantly less for the same work.

I normally avoid leaving negative reviews, but I genuinely feel students and local residents should be careful before printing or binding anything here. Please confirm the exact rates clearly before giving your work.

Ironically sending this using their internet as they are that rude and ignorant of their state.

Owner also seems extremely conceited and made me feel really small when bargaining, especially when he is charging me over what is written in his shop.

Disgusting behavior, stay away there exists 200+ better alternatives. (Understatement)

user_reviews.Name: ASHRITHA SARAM
user_reviews.Description:
We have been working with this printing shop regularly, and it has always been our first choice for all our printing needs.
.
We have placed bulk orders multiple times for banners, company diaries, pens, bottles, welcome kits, card holders, T-shirts (US Polo), Parker pens, and more. Every single time, they delivered the items on time, even when we requested urgent or short-notice delivery. Nothing was missed, and the quality has always been consistent and reliable.
.
The team is very responsive and they handle customers with a lot of patience and respect.
.
A special mention to Ravi sir, who has been helping us throughout and we are in regular contact with him and he is extremely supportive & responsive.
.
On a personal note, I visited the shop twice during lunch/snack time, and they were kind enough to offer food as well — a small gesture, but it really shows how respectful and customer-focused they are.
.
Overall, we have placed 3–4 different orders with them so far, and the experience has been good every time.
.
Highly recommended for bulk and urgent printing with good quality and service.
